messages:
Ben: Quick follow-up on last night's GPU autoscale shortfall. Collecting owners + concrete dates so we can close these loopbacks. ScaleBot, paste the concise incident summary.
ScaleBot: INC-2026-117: symptom: delayed node provisioning + increased pod churn after batch eval spike at 04:10 UTC. Peak pending pods ~420. Autoscaler observed 503/504 backend retries; scale actions lagged by avg 140s. Impact window ~04:08-05:00 UTC.
Isha: Noting recurring cadence: multiple teams' heavy evals concentrated in the 04:00-05:30 UTC window. We've got a pattern: 5 incidents in 10 weeks with similar shape. Long-term fix needs scheduling policy + capacity buffer.
Marta: Short-term infra changes I can own: set evictionGracePeriod lower for low-priority pods and enable short-lived preemptible nodes for burst scale. Example snippet I'll test in staging:
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
spec:
  terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 10
  priorityClassName: low-priority
```
I'll open infra PR tonight.
Omar: I'll coordinate with teams running evals to add per-team concurrency fences. Suggest enforcing maxConcurrentJobs=6 for eval-crons and staggering offsets by 5m. I'll draft a proposal and notify owners by EOD.
Yuri: I'll run synthetic spike tests (500 small pods) against staging autoscaler v2 and capture scale latency + API retry metrics. Target: run today and post results here.
Ben: Proposed action list:
- CLOUD-5500  Omar  quota/short-term burst pool request (20 GPUs)  submit today, expect 3bd approval
- infra#2017  Marta  eviction/short-lived preemptible nodes PR  staging tests by Thu
- scheduling policy docs & cron-stagger  Omar & Isha  proposal by Tue, rollout plan by next week
- synthetic canary + metrics baseline  Yuri  run today, post dashboard panels by Wed
- retrospective + recurring-pattern tracker  Ben  add monthly incident pattern check and thresholds to runbook by Fri
Please ack or call blockers.
Isha: ack :+1: I'll update capacity forecast sheet with 90/95th percentile spike numbers and recommended buffer.
Marta: infra#2017 opened: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/2017. Running unit tests now. Will tag for canary when green.
Omar: Draft posted to docs repo: eval-throttling.md. Will assign owners and schedule the cron-offset change during low-traffic window.
Yuri: Synthetic run finished: autoscaler v2 scaled to 100 nodes in 3m45s with median boot time 18s, but API retry spikes correlate with control-plane throttling. Uploading traces to the dashboard.
Ben: Good data. Omar, if cloud approvals lag, we'll enable manual short-lived dedicated pool as fallback. ScaleBot, remind this thread in 48h for status check.
ScaleBot: Reminder scheduled for +48h.
Ben: Thanks team. Closing tracking thread; will reopen if canary shows regressions.
